fq1_q: A garage already replaced parts. Can you find it?
fq1_a: Yes. It's our most common case. We start from zero, with measurements, not assumptions.
fq2_q: My AdBlue or emissions light is on. Is it serious?
fq2_a: Don't wait. On many models a countdown limits power and then blocks restarting. The cause is often a NOx sensor, the dosing system or the AdBlue quality. We measure before we change anything.
fq3_q: How much does a diagnosis cost?

fq5_q: My warning light went off by itself. Should I still come?
fq5_a: Yes, the fault stays stored in memory. Better to read it before it comes back at the wrong moment.

pv_meta_desc: What data this site collects, how it is used (cookies, Google advertising, WhatsApp) and your rights.
pv_intro: This page explains what information this site (khabirdiag.com) may collect, why, and how you can control it.
pv_1_p: Khabir Diagnostic Auto Pro, an electronic diagnostics workshop near Pharmacie Hay Redouane, Hay Redouane, Beni Mellal 23000, Morocco. Contact: by WhatsApp or phone, using the numbers on the Contact page.
pv_2_p: This site has no customer accounts and no forms. If you message us on WhatsApp or call us, we receive your number and the information you choose to send (car model, symptom, photos). We use it only to answer your request, prepare a quote and organise the work.
pv_3_p: Like any website, our host (Vercel) records technical connection data (IP address, browser, requested page) to keep the site secure and working. The site remembers your language choice in a preference cookie that lasts one year.
pv_4_p: The site may show ads served by Google AdSense. Google and its partners may use cookies or identifiers to serve and measure ads, including ads personalised from your browsing on this and other sites. You can manage or turn off personalised ads at https://adssettings.google.com and see how Google uses data at https://policies.google.com/technologies/partner-sites.
pv_5_p: The map on the home page is provided by Google Maps. Links to WhatsApp, Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, X, Pinterest and Reddit open those services, which apply their own privacy policies.
pv_6_p: You can ask to access, correct or delete information you sent us (for example the number and photos kept on WhatsApp) by contacting us. In Morocco, law 09-08 protects personal data.
pv_7_p: This policy may change. The date of the last update is at the top of the page.

tm_intro: By using this site you accept the terms below.
tm_1_p: The articles and fault code pages are general guides. They do not replace a diagnosis carried out on your vehicle by a professional. The same fault can have different causes depending on the model, age and condition of the car.
tm_2_p: We do our best to keep the information accurate, but we do not guarantee that it is complete or up to date. Do not carry out a repair based only on a page: have it measured first.
tm_3_p: If a safety warning light comes on (brakes, steering, airbag, overheating, oil pressure) or the car behaves unusually, stop safely and ask for help before driving on.
tm_4_p: No prices are shown on this site. Any price is given in writing, on request, before the work.
tm_5_p: The texts, images and videos on this site belong to Khabir Diagnostic Auto Pro. You may quote a short extract with a link to the original page; copying a full page is not allowed without written permission. Official code definitions come from the SAE J2012 standard and the open dtc-database (MIT licence).
tm_6_p: This site links to third-party services (WhatsApp, social networks, Google Maps). We do not control their content.
tm_7_p: These terms are governed by Moroccan law.
